THE VIRAL EDIT CONTEST

About
The mission behind The Viral Edit Contest

The Viral Edit Contest (TVEC) is the first platform connecting sponsors — artists, labels, studios, brands, creators, communities — with video editors through paid TikTok edit contests. A sponsor launches a contest with a cashprize, dozens of editors create edits, and the best ones get paid.

Why we built TVEC

Every day, thousands of editors make songs, films and brands blow up on TikTok — often for free, with no recognition or pay. On the other side, artists and brands spend fortunes on ads for reach that feels artificial. A fair bridge between the two was missing.

Our mission

Make editing a skill that is finally paid what it's worth, and give sponsors authentic organic reach for the price of a regular campaign. We want creating a viral edit to become a real way to earn a living — transparent, deserved, with no opaque middleman.

What we stand for
Fair pay

PayPal withdrawal from €10. TVEC fee of 2% of the net sent, shown before confirmation.

Transparency & anti-fraud

TikTok views verified automatically, independent juries, blind mode available to rate without bias.

Quality first

Winners are picked on talent and brief accuracy, not on the size of their audience.

Organic reach

Dozens of authentic edits that keep running long after the contest ends.

How it works
A sponsor launches a contest: theme, brief, assets, cashprize and duration. 24h validation.
Editors create their edit, publish it on TikTok and submit the link before the deadline.
An expert jury rates quality, the algorithm counts real views, winners are selected and paid.
Who's behind TVEC

TVEC is operated by Lilian Barrancos EI, an independent French sole proprietorship based in Paris. No large group, no investors: a project built step by step, close to editors and sponsors, with one obsession — paying creators fairly and fast.

A question, an idea, a partnership? Get in touch or join the Discord community.
